Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from this section's selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge or memory.
The freeway entry and exit paragraphs on the first selected page refer to figures printed on a later page; those figures were not read and are not described [A01].
The second selected page calls the entry and exit points of controlled-access highways intersections; that label is not taught because it conflicts with the same sentence saying such highways have no intersections (verify AZ-FWY-D-TERM) [A02].
The freeway-stop paragraph points to a later page for the move-over rule; only the instruction printed here (slow, move over, pass with caution) is taught [A02].
The HOV hours are stated only as posted times on weekdays; no hour range is invented [A03].
Originality: every statement is reworded from the cited page; no manual sentence, table, image or official test question is reproduced.
Exam numbers: the manual prints no question count, passing score, item format or time limit, so none is stated anywhere in this section; the typed debts live in part A.
External review: restating published Arizona traffic and licensing rules needs no clinical or legal sign-off; none is requested.
